APORIA / LACUNATHEME RECORD — 01

Made for code.

Two editions, one identity. Aporia's canonical semantic tokens generate the color themes for Helix, Zed, VS Code and terminal emulators. These 24 specimens are browser illustrations, not screenshots of the editors.

LACUNA PAPER01 / LIGHT
theme/resolve.tsTypeScript · generated
// Aporia / Lacuna
interface Theme { name: string; mode: 'paper' | 'ink'; }
const themes: Theme[] = [
  { name: 'Lacuna Paper', mode: 'paper' },
  { name: 'Lacuna Ink', mode: 'ink' },
];
function resolve(mode: Theme['mode']) {
  return themes.find(theme => theme.mode === mode);
}
